<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sigmafi/orders/{boxId}/fill"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

</MethodEndpoint>



Lend the principal to the borrower. The fill mints two units with the order's box id as token id: one circulating claim to this wallet and one singleton locked in the bond. Whoever holds the claim receives the repayment plus the unused reserve, or the collateral after maturity liquidation. The lender funds the reserve above the borrower's full collateral value.
